digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate measurement and benchmarking harness
propositions: Deterministic seeded-defect mutant corpus, pre-registered thresholds, mutation-assembly script, and pure counting helpers were designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 but intentionally not landed on main.

Five defect classes (absent capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, untagged operational AC) were seeded mechanically into real cleanly-closed plans to construct ground-truth labels.

The expensive ~100-run LLM batch baseline sweep over the mutant/control corpus was permanently rejected on cost and superseded by story d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder, which accumulates detection/blocking-FP signal from real production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.
Store isolation mechanism implemented by git clone --local to prevent real .tickets-tracker contamination during mutation testing.
History-based baseline mining is infeasible: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist against ~200 needed due to impact_model_version bump stranding the historical data.
